5a616a6770992ae50e374de10b67725c025cbb6e.ja: URAZUKE は、公開資料の数値・記載・分析を自動で検証し、確かめられたことと未解決の論点を記録します。Claude・GPT がコードで検証し、別系統の AI が反証を試みます（各記録に検証の状態を表示）。運営者は個別の内容審査を行わず、手順の設計・運用と訂正を担い、最終的な責任を負います。
5a616a6770992ae50e374de10b67725c025cbb6e.en: URAZUKE automatically verifies the figures, statements and analyses in published materials, and records what has been confirmed and the issues that remain unresolved. Claude and GPT carry out the verification using code, and an independent model attempts a refutation (the verification status is shown on each record). The operator does not review individual content; the operator is responsible for designing and running the procedures and for corrections, and bears final responsibility.

58edb3dac4118d4998b02396f1d74e39b52d75b7.en: The scripts, the list of retrieved materials and the basis for each record are published on GitHub, so the same calculations can be reproduced from the same materials. URAZUKE's own records are also subject to verification, and are updated or corrected in response to objections or additional materials.

The original claim was withdrawn and narrowed to the fact that some editions have no such pointing note (the 2020, 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025 editions (Reiwa 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7)). The point raised in a refutation by an independent model (R022, a run whose verdict is not adopted because of deficient controls) was confirmed against the materials.
